summary: This BCP gives implementation and operational advice for using TLS Pre-Shared Keys with RADIUS/TLS (RFC 6614) and RADIUS/DTLS (RFC 7360). It aims to ease moving from RADIUS/UDP to RADIUS/TLS.

eli5.summary: Moving to a safer way of talking with shared secrets can be bumpy. This is a how-to guide for doing it smoothly.

questions: how to move from radius udp to tls
